title: 4 days after graduation (career-ops)
caption:
4 days after graduation. 60 applications. 0 replies. 😩

The problem? Same resume, 60 times.

career-ops (80k ⭐ on GitHub, free, open source) runs inside Claude Code:
1️⃣ Install in one line
2️⃣ Scans career pages of 100+ companies
3️⃣ Scores every job 1–5 against your CV, skips ghost postings
4️⃣ Tailored ATS resume + cover letter for each job
5️⃣ Fills the form. YOU press submit.

Send this to a friend who just graduated 🎓
tip: Post in the evening. Any comment still gets the follow-gate DM.
